headline: SMV1245 branch junction-delivery transfer T(f)=|V_j/V_bt| (package R-L + junction C + element-accurate stub)

provenance.stub_table_source: R6 element-accurate stub S-param, relocated to results/stub_tables/smv1245_stub_55GHz.s1p (0.05-55 GHz, 5496 pts); read read-only. Regenerated by boundary/branch_delivery_runner.py (reproduces these arrays to ~1e-12).
provenance.formula: T = |Z_C/(Z_pkg+Z_C+Z_stub)|; Z_pkg=2.0+jw*0.7nH; Z_C=1/(jwC0); Z_stub=1/Y_stub(f) from table
provenance.C0_convention: C0=7.37pF (junction CJ0=6.9pF + CP=0.47pF, R6 convention). CAVEAT: CP strictly PARALLELS the junction, so the total shunt cap at the node IS 7.37pF and is the correct divider C; junction-only CJ0=6.9pF gives Z_C ~6.8%% smaller.
